basis.interpretation: Head trauma in a patient on warfarin carries high risk for intracranial bleeding; anticoagulation increases hemorrhage severity and delayed presentation is common.

basis.quote: Today I have a bad headache and I've thrown up twice
basis.interpretation: New headache and vomiting after head trauma are concerning for intracranial injury, including epidural or subdural hematoma; these symptoms warrant urgent imaging and neurological assessment.

Anticoagulation therapy substantially increases risk of serious intracranial hemorrhage after traumatic head injury and complicates safe observation; urgent imaging and coagulation assessment are required.
